steps.content:
October 3, 11:49 AM
Border of Districts 13, 14, 15 - Abandoned apartment
This is the first time you are participating in one of the Bureau's arrest operations. The Bureau's arrest team is already at the scene.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Wow! This is the first time I'm actually on the cops' side. I used to always get chased, but now I'm the one chasing others... How come I feel like a snitch?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Since we're doing this... ${PlayerName}, can you give me a Bureau uniform? I haven't tried out this style yet. It's pretty exciting!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Hella, be serious. We lack experience working with the arrest team, and we also face a lot of obstacles operating in Eastside. Our opponent is not weak.
Since Nightingale stayed behind to look after the Bureau, the captain of the city arrest team is in charge of the field. He comes over to report to you.

steps.speaker: Arrest Team Captain
steps.content: We have completely surrounded the target area. There are many homeless people here, so we could not immediately pinpoint the target's precise location. She really excels at hiding her tracks.

steps.speaker: Arrest Team Captain
steps.content: Chief, should we attack, or try to collect more intelligence?
According to Doyle's notes, "Mess" is an escape expert and a master of hiding. She might have set up an ambush or have accomplices. For ordinary arrest team members, Ambrosia is also a threat.
But you're also prepared. You're going to use a familiar "flexible" strategy that will neither tip her off nor waste this rare opportunity.

steps.speaker: Bar Staff
steps.content: ...Wh-what are you looking at me for? I did everything you asked me to. What else do you want?

steps.speaker: Choice
options: I still need... A little bit of help from you...

steps.speaker: Bar Staff
steps.content: Y-you... No...!!

October 3, 7:00 PM
Border of Districts 13, 14, 15 - Abandoned apartment

Mess finally returns, humming a little tune. She still has the big patched bear on her back, and her purple braids sway from side to side as she skips. She is shocked when she sees the waiter squatting alone on the side of the street waiting for her.

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: ...How did you find me here? I never told you...

steps.speaker: Bar Staff
steps.content: I came here by myself... After your little scene last night, officials came and confiscated all the Ambrosia in our bar... The boss can't wait until the next delivery day...

steps.speaker: Bar Staff
steps.content: So... Can you, maybe sell us a bit of stock reserved for other buyers? I... I'll get you new games next time...

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: Sure, sure... Hey. That's what friends are for. Come with me!
She suddenly puts on a smile, wraps her arm around the waiter's neck, and leads him into the abandoned building. You and the Sinners follow them quietly from a distance.
After passing dust, gravel, broken furniture, and homeless people sprawled out on the ground, you finally arrive at a repair mezzanine.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: <size=30><color=#7683a2>There's no one else here. It's her private base.</size> </color>
You nod and brief the arrest team outside. They will act soon. Right now, everything is up to the waiter.

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: Sit. Don't be so nervous. I'll get you something nice to eat.

steps.speaker: Bar Staff
steps.content: Mmm...
Mess rummages through her messy wooden boxes, leaving the waiter to fidget by himself.

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: How did you find me here? I only moved here a few days ago, and I've been changing the pickup spot.

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: Ha... Were you following me?

steps.speaker: Bar Staff
steps.content: No, no... Actually, I...

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: You're not in love with me, are you?

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: Haha, I'm just messing with you. Don't be so nervous. Here's some water to drink and something to eat. Or wanna play a game? The game you gave me a while ago is really fun!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: My, my. I'm starting to sympathize with that boy.
She gives him some water and cookies, and stares at him with mysterious eyes.

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: Actually, I just decided to move tonight because the cops got their eyes on this place, too. I really don't know who snitched on me... Sigh, I was just starting to like it here.

steps.speaker: Bar Staff
steps.content: Cough cough!

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: I made too much of a commotion last night. Sorry for getting you into trouble. As an apology, feel free to make yourself at home. Didn't you say you wanted to see my base?

steps.speaker: Bar Staff
steps.content: Mmm... Yeah... Mmm...

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: Haha, you're usually quite the silver-tongued talker. But now that you're actually in a girl's home, you can't even string a sentence together? What are you so nervous about?
She squats down in front of him and stares into his eyes as she caresses his head. The waiter instantly freezes.

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: Are you scared because you found out I'm a Sinner? Or is it because the three new friends outside bullied you?

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: Or maybe... You were the one who led them here in the first place?

steps.speaker: Bar Staff
steps.content: Ahhhhh, no!! Help me! I don't want to get killed by a Sinner!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: What the...? that idiot spilled everything just like that?!
Mess bellows with laughter. She presses down on the waiter's face, muffling his screams. She then turns her head and stops the incoming Hella.

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: Do not come over! I just started to have some fun. Don't get in my way.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Just give up. He has no value as a hostage. We don't care about him.

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: I care about him. He's my baby. I never viewed him as a hostage.
She walks behind him as she speaks, her hand still on his face, muffling his words. She rubs his frightened eyes playfully, as if she's enjoying the whole situation.

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: You said I'm your friend. You came to me pleading for stock, yet in the end, you stalked me, betrayed me, and stabbed me in the back. Let me guess why you're doing this...

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: You want to get rid of me as the middleman and take all the Ambrosia and cash for yourself, right?

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: You went to them on your own, right? Even though they beat you up, it's worth it to get rid of me, right?

steps.speaker: Bar Staff
steps.content: Mm! Mmmmm!!

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: Hahahahaha! Great job! I love villains like you! Evil yet dumb! You're really awesome!

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: Hand over all your malice!
A beam of powerful energy bursts from her palm. She pulls back her hand, extracting a mass of dark substance from him. The waiter lets out a scream, then slumps to the ground unconscious.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ****! You killed him?!

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: I'm not a villain. I don't kill people. It just took a little bit of spiritual energy from him.

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: Don't worry, malice is a renewable resource. Villains like him will recover quickly.
She admires the twisted substance in her hands. She speaks as if she's explaining something, but also talking to herself.

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: I knew that one day, you'd become its captive, get infected by its malice, and become its lackey...

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: I have to do my best. After all, I am the only one who dares to face it, and only I can forge a sword that can destroy it...
As she speaks, she takes out the cast of a sword and injects it with the black energy in her hand. The cast quickly turns red, melts, expands, and transforms into a long, golden-red sword.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: That weapon has become stronger! This Sinner's power is...

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: Forging of Malice.

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: I am the spirit-forger Mess. I extract malice from people's hearts to forge weapons. The evil thoughts of hurting others will become the power of this sword.
With one swing, the sword shatters half the wall, blocking the arrest team that had just arrived.
They are no match against this Sinner. You have to try your best to divert Mess's attention.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Is this why you spread Ambrosia and collect "black goo"?

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: Yes, the "black goo" is a precious raw material for me. Though its purity isn't high, there's always something usable. Plus, I don't need to activate my power and set off the alarms when using Ambrosia.

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: Those who drink Ambrosia get sweet dreams, and I get the malice I need to forge swords. It's safe, environmentally friendly and it's a win-win for all. Isn't it wonderful?

steps.speaker: Choice
options: You just claimed to be a reseller.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Then who's your supplier? Who gave you the Ambrosia? Who made it? What's their goal?

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: Sigh, you're so boring. Ambrosia is just a tool. What I want is malice, so that I can forge a good sword to defeat that monster.

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: He's getting stronger and stronger. If no one stops him, all of mankind will be contaminated by malice, and the whole world will be destroyed...
You become vigilant. The spread of Ambrosia, the new strain of Mania, the strange zeal in Mess's eyes... You recall the 9th Agency's hints, and the "Marv" case recounted by Doyle...
Does all of this point to some great conspiracy?

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: Him? You don't know? You've never seen him?
Mess looks at you and smiles. Countless possible answers flash through your mind, each one making you sweat.

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: Hahaha, you know who he is. We all know. He is the source of all malice, the culprit who defiles people's hearts, and the most terrifying monster in the world...

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: <size=40><color=#fb9259>The Master Dreadlord</color></size>!

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: Only a blade sharpened by darkness can cut through darkness. Only sorcery can defeat sorcery.

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: Only with a sacred sword forged from malice can we defeat the source of all evil—the Great Dreadlord!

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: Oh, he has many. Draco, Satan, Diablo... Everyone knows him, but no one dares to call him by his name, so people gave him thousands of aliases.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: These names all sound familiar...

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: Like... a dragon, a great big dragon... With ears like this, and a long, long tail... Oh, and he breathes fire! Let me see. Does he have three heads or just one...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Oh, I remember! It's the dumb monster from an old game EMP likes to play!

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: Hehe, tricking you? No, it's what I dedicated my life to! Unlike people like you who only know how to escape, I will forge a sacred sword strong enough to defeat it. I will destroy it with its own malice.

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: But this amount of malice isn't enough... Not enough to defeat it...
She looks at you with madness blazing in her eyes. Hecate and Hella immediately stand guard in front of you.

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: Are you just a boring nice guy? You drank so much Ambrosia but didn't spit out anything useful.

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: But those beside you are different. They are my kind.

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: If I did something to you, will your companions produce malice towards me?

steps.speaker: Hella & Hecate
steps.content:
In your ******* dreams!
Don't even think about coming close to him!
steps.female_content:
In your ******* dreams!
Don't even think about coming close to her!

steps.content: Mess cackles with laughter. She cuts the shelf next to her with her blade, sending the bottles and jars on it crashing to the ground. Berserk black goo spill out from the broken containers.
